provenance.sourceAccessMethod: Read assigned index.html, sources.md and independent-check.md completely, then full retained independent-arithmetic-results.json and fee-schedule TXT. No new external lookup or source refresh and no other source-run folder. README/voice first, batch29 Nairobi JSON/English Markdown as structure only. Registry URLs all occur verbatim in assigned source ledger; ledger dates all reads November 7, 2026. Local copying does not refresh them.
provenance.originalResearchAccessLimitations: Original whole run was not clean-session-only. Early public fetches/accordion and search fallback used existing managed profiles of unestablished storage state. Later empty-cookie/origin incognito checks and complete PDF/workbook downloads do not erase that exception. Current author did not inspect browser profiles or replay historical activity. Original no-contact/no-account statements are retained declarations, not a complete independently audited activity log.
provenance.independentCheckDisposition: Retained independent results: 52 monetary checks pass plus four exact source-workbook rating/name row assertions. Input index/source hashes agree with current bytes. Previously missing AgeWell/Regis evidence payloads resolved by recovered original output in continuation; not open. U1/U2 hierarchy, original session exceptions and personal/provider facts remain open. Current author reads results, not a claim of rerunning original file-writing script.
provenance.layoutEvidenceLimit: Source review records director layout sign-off and says reviewer did not duplicate pixel review. No new-page build/render/browser check in this authoring shard; no visual certification claimed.

datePolicy: Original source ledger explicitly dates reads November 7, 2026; retain that date, distinguish publication/effective dates. No invented publication date or 2027 MPIR. Fee schedule September 20, 2026; deeming threshold July 1, 2026. MPIR October 1–December 31, 2026 fixed at room-price agreement, DAP separately indexed. Maintenance window and family timeline are explicitly dated, not enduring current claims.
recommendation: Secure safe care first; start needs/financial assessments together, retain home temporarily and use DAP as a bridge. Seek appropriately licensed specialist aged-care financial advice before sale, rent, borrowing or large RAD. Do not force unsafe waiting, an unsuitable placement or distressed sale.

planningAssumptions.profile: Daniel's 82-year-old widowed Australian-citizen Mandarin-speaking mother on full pension; Glen Waverley/Box Hill care preferences.
planningAssumptions.targetStatus: Family goal, not placement or assessment guarantee
planningAssumptions.conditionalZeroNCCC: Depends on minimum pension supplement/energy exclusions not established within original specified source hierarchy; actual Services Australia fee advice needed.

scenarioRows.choice: Keep vacant, partial RAD plus DAP

scenarioRows.ncccStatus: maximum under assumptions regardless of pension exclusion
scenarioRows.pension: Reassessment required; do not assume full pension or assert exact entitlement

planningAssumptions.rounding: Means annual /364; DAP/retention /365. Accommodation/retention daily cents before multiplying days. First retention assumes balance unchanged until deduction; subsequent amounts fall, timing can differ. No forced retention-only RAD top-up.
planningAssumptions.otherAssumptions: Sole debt-free ownership, vacant retained home, no protected occupant, no other assets/income, contents amounts, grandfathering or prior cap credits. Disclose real facts. Sale before costs/tax. No assumed rent, investment cash return, growth, loan or exact post-sale pension.
planningAssumptions.excludedCosts: Extras, medication/personal spending, home rates/insurance/maintenance, sale/letting expenses, tax, loan costs, interim DAP before RAD receipt, future indices and wealth/cap changes.
